blurb: Candidate: AI Product Engineer and solo founder in Saudi Arabia who ships production LLM systems end to end — prompt engineering, LLM evaluation pipelines, output validation and guardrails, agentic workflows, and AI observability. Founder of Watheq, an Arabic-first AI resume and job-matching SaaS built solo and live in production: React 19 and TypeScript front end, Supabase/PostgreSQL with role-based access control, Netlify serverless functions, payment integration, and Sentry monitoring. Also runs production automation on GitHub Actions in Python, including multi-source ATS integrations, a paid aggregator API integration with monthly quota budgeting and cursor paging, employer-source verification that recovers a free apply link behind a paid relister, and LLM fit-scoring with deterministic fallbacks. Built and operates a Cloudflare Workers service backing a Discord bot: slash commands, request signature verification, a shared signed HTTP client, D1 schema, and webhook-fallback delivery. Ships JD-aware resume tailoring under enforced output contracts, where every fit note and gap has to survive an evidence check against the resume. Works plan-first and test-first: written plans per change, TDD, and a CI workflow guard. Python, TypeScript and SQL, with 5+ years across software engineering and data analytics (Power BI, segmentation, competitor and pricing analysis). Native Arabic, and builds for Saudi-market edge cases like Hijri dates and Arabic parsing. Wants SENIOR-LEVEL INDIVIDUAL CONTRIBUTOR roles (AI/ML, software, product, or data) based in Saudi Arabia, and is open to lead, staff, principal, or head-of titles when the role is hands-on technical ownership of the kind he already does. He has built and operated whole production systems solo but has never managed a team, so a role that is mostly people management is a weaker fit than one that is mostly building. MUST BE BASED IN SAUDI ARABIA: not roles based outside Saudi Arabia, even with relocation offered. Values simple, reliable, high-ownership work. EDUCATION: holds a diploma in Pipefitting Technology from Saudi Petroleum Services Polytechnic (2018) and NO bachelor's degree. Everything he does in software and AI is self-taught and shipped rather than credentialed. A posting that states a bachelor's degree as a minimum qualification is a real gap he does not meet, and it belongs in the reason; a degree written as 'preferred' or 'or equivalent experience' is not. WHAT HE DOES NOT DO: he BUILDS WITH models, he does not build models. No training, fine-tuning, or evaluation of ML models he authored; no TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, deep learning, MLOps or feature engineering anywhere in his experience, and no formal study of statistics or data science. 'Evaluation' in his work means judge-scoring LLM prompt and model variants, not measuring a model he trained. A posting requiring model development, fine-tuning or a classical ML stack is a wrong-function match however much AI vocabulary it shares with his, and belongs in the 0-39 band rather than scored as a near miss.

tracks.name: AI and LLM product engineering
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Watheq experience entry and the job-search digest project entry in the resume. Do not credit this track from the summary or skills lines. This is LLM application engineering only: the resume shows no model training, fine-tuning, TensorFlow, PyTorch or scikit-learn anywhere.

tracks.name: Software engineering, front and back
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Watheq experience entry and the projects section. Frontend is real here and is the largest single thing he has shipped: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vite and Zustand, 28,000+ lines in production. Backend is Supabase/PostgreSQL, serverless functions and Python automation. Note the dates: full-time software engineering runs from Aug 2025, so a posting asking for several years of it is a real gap.

tracks.name: Data and analytics
tracks.evidence: Judge against the Alghalia experience entry, which runs from Mar 2020. It is business analytics and reporting, not machine-learning modelling or large-scale data engineering: the resume shows no Spark, Kafka, Airflow or warehouse ETL anywhere.
